description: This file is a report module for production plan summary in an ERP system, generating a tabular report with production and order details.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves production plan data, including work order and purchase order details.

methods.name: get_production_plan_item_details
methods.description: Fetches and appends production plan item details to data.

methods.name: get_production_plan_sub_assembly_item_details
methods.description: Fetches sub-assembly items related to production plan and appends details.

methods.name: get_work_order_details
methods.description: Retrieves work order details for the production plan.

methods.name: get_purchase_order_details
methods.description: Retrieves purchase order item details for the production plan.

methods.name: get_column
methods.description: Defines the columns for the production plan summary report.
